declarations.state_ownership: Owns the twelve co_* tables of migration 0048 (lobster-factory/packages/db/migrations/0048_co_outreach_core.sql) co_evidence (0150: one row per fact research found, organization_id taken from the lead by trigger) and co_send_claims (0152: one row per auto send claimed, counted for the mailbox / sender-domain / recipient caps; claims older than 31 days are deleted by sender-health), RLS on with service-role-only policies; organization_id is the tenant boundary: staff choose the client they operate for, a customer on the outreach door (outreach.<base domain>, app/outreach) is bound to its own organization -- every route opens its database through lib/outreach/db-client.ts outreachDb (a customer's requested slug is ignored) and scopes rows with effectiveOrgId / assertOrgAccess; ON DELETE CASCADE from organizations. Connector API keys and Gmail refresh tokens are in the Supabase Vault (migration 0049), only their reference in co_connector_accounts.credentials_ref (app/api/outreach/connectors/secret/route.ts:7-10, lib/outreach/google-oauth.ts header). co_connector_usage and co_timeline_events have no code reference today (grep over app and lib); co_verified_emails is the MX-check cache, definitive answers only (lib/outreach/verify-email.ts), overwritten by a paid verdict (provider hunter / zerobounce, verified_at; mailbox-verify.ts).
declarations.behavior_ownership: Lead import, scoring and de-duplication (app/api/outreach/inbox, leads; lib/outreach/normalize.ts, scoring.ts), the Cold Gate and message lint (lib/outreach/cold-gate.ts:1-7), AI draft generation -- two first-email variants with subjects plus follow-ups, assembled by lib/outreach/brand-context.ts, guarded by generation-schema.ts, gated by cold-gate.ts gateMessage -- and review (app/api/outreach/messages/route.ts POST, PATCH; review-policy.ts, claim-check.ts), sender signatures (app/api/outreach/senders), lead-to-profile assignment (leads PATCH), Gmail draft creation (messages/gmail-draft/route.ts), Gmail OAuth (connectors/gmail/authorize, oauth/callback; google-oauth.ts; ?pool=1&poolEmail= connects a sender-pool mailbox: the Google account must be the typed address, then send_mode auto, 50/day, warm-up w1, sender.ts connectedSenderFields), sender-pool health (lib/outreach/sender-health.ts: daily DNS, 7-day hard-bounce rate, warm-up step; senders POST recheck = the recover button), the sender pool and automatic send (sender-pool.ts pickSender at generation, send-adapter.ts at the end of each reply-sync tick, mailbox-verify.ts paid verification; senders POST send_mode = the 自動寄出 switch, the address typed back), the stats page (app/api/outreach/stats, lib/outreach/stats.ts), the pipeline (lib/outreach/pipeline.ts runPipelineTick in each reply-sync tick before send-adapter: research, generation, sampled review policy, follow-ups approved with an auto-approved first email when their gate passed, Gmail drafts and due follow-up drafts for in-pool mailboxes only; per-step cap 20 and a per-org daily budget of pool caps x 1.5; generation and drafting live in lib/outreach/generate.ts and draft.ts, shared with the two routes), the review queue (app/api/outreach/review-queue, review/QueueClient.tsx), follow-ups in the first email's thread (C5: In-Reply-To / References, threadId; no_reply after the last step), suppression list, service profiles and follow-ups.
declarations.public_api_event_contract: HTTP /api/outreach/{connectors, connectors/secret, connectors/gmail/authorize, connectors/gmail/oauth/callback, followups, inbox, leads, messages, messages/gmail-draft, senders, service-profiles, stats, suppression}; internal POST /api/internal/outreach/sender-health (Bearer OUTREACH_SYNC_TOKEN, unset = 401), rung daily by the host cron (scripts/cron.d/awarewave-schedules, lib/schedules/host-jobs.ts outreach_sender_health); DB functions co_begin_send / co_convert_to_warm / co_recipient_cap_key (0152, service_role only); writes require canManageOutreach (owner/admin/operator; a door customer resolves to operator, lib/ops-role.ts CLIENT_PRODUCT_ROLE); reads rely on the middleware session plus the per-route organization scope; the door serves /api/outreach only to an account holding the product (lib/portal/door-access.ts). The OAuth callback is a public path (middleware.ts PUBLIC_API_PATHS) trusting only the HMAC-signed state, which also carries the return page and the database slug. Outbound: Google OAuth and the Gmail API with the gmail.compose + gmail.readonly scopes (google-oauth.ts GMAIL_SCOPES), Claude / OpenAI / Gemini through the AI gateway (lib/outreach/ai-claude.ts, ai-openai.ts, ai-gemini.ts). DNS lookups of the pool mailboxes' own domains (node:dns, sender-health.ts checkDns). Hunter /v2/email-verifier and ZeroBounce /v2/validate with the organization's or the agency's key from the vault (mailbox-verify.ts verifierKey), only for an address about to be sent automatically. No webhook, no Trigger task (grep packages/workflows/src/trigger for outreach: none).
declarations.invariants: Nothing is sent while a sender account is in send_mode='draft': the gmail.compose scope itself permits drafts.send, so the guard is code, not scope -- lib/outreach/__tests__/never-sends.test.ts scans every shipped file in app/ and lib/: only google-oauth.ts names the Gmail API host and spells the send endpoint, once, in sendGmailDraft, and no file but lib/outreach/send-adapter.ts (the auto-send seam, SPEC I3, card C8) calls it; send-adapter reads only send_mode='auto' healthy mailboxes linked to their connector, sends only Taipei 09-18 Monday to Friday within the warm-up stage caps (sender-pool.ts), re-runs the Cold Gate and contact-guard, and sends only to an address a paid verifier (mailbox-verify.ts, Hunter / ZeroBounce, grant outreach.verify) called valid in the last 90 days -- no verifier key = no automatic send; a send that may have gone out (timeout, 5xx, 404) stays 'sending' and is never resent, reconciled by gmail-sync (30 minutes still a draft = needs_edit, claim released); a Gmail 4xx refusal gives the mail back and pauses the mailbox -- and generated text is stored as a draft, or approved only by a profile in sampled review when the gate passes, the lead is outside the sample and the fact check (outreach.qa) says supported (review-policy.ts autoApproves; SPEC D23). Every stored email ends with its mailbox signature and, for a lead that did not publish its own address, carries the personal-data notice; both are appended by code and an edited body is gated again (cold-gate.ts gateMessage, messages/route.ts PATCH). At most one first email per lead is approved/drafted/sent (migration 0149 co_messages_one_first_email; 409 variant_already_approved), and one lead per email per organization (co_leads_org_email_uniq; 409 duplicate_email). Before a draft is created the lead is re-checked for do_not_contact, suppression (applies_to cold/all, read by lib/outreach/suppression.ts without truncation and matched case-insensitively) and a live MX check of the address, answered 409 {blocked, reason} (gmail-draft/route.ts, lib/outreach/contact-guard.ts; SPEC I6). Every draft carries List-Unsubscribe (google-oauth.ts buildRfc2822Message). drafted is never set by the client: gmail-draft takes the row (approved to drafted, conditional, drafted_at = take time) just before the Gmail call, drafts the content it took from the mailbox named at generation (prompt_snapshot.sender_id), gives the row back if the call fails, and retakes a take older than 10 minutes that has no draft_created event (gmail-draft/route.ts STALE_TAKE_MS). An auto send claims its slot in one transaction (0152 co_begin_send): the lead row is locked and re-checked (cold-gate.ts NO_COLD_STATUSES, do_not_contact, suppression), the sender domain and the recipient key are advisory-locked in sorted order, and the mailbox-today, sender-domain-today and recipient-30-day caps are counted from unreleased claims; the recipient key is the whole address on a free-mail domain (the SQL list equals research-extract.ts FREE_MAIL, free-mail-parity.test.ts), else the domain. co_convert_to_warm takes the same lead lock, so a warm conversion and a send never interleave (packages/db/tests/test_0152_sender_pool.py races). The daily draft limit is a live count of today's draft_created events on the Asia/Taipei day (gmail-draft/route.ts todayStartUtcIso). The Cold Gate refuses generation without approved evidence (co_evidence; the old observation + source_url until card C9), for a do_not_contact lead, or for any lead past the cold sequence (cold-gate.ts NO_COLD_STATUSES, meta_lead_ad), with 422 (messages/route.ts POST, cold-gate.ts checkColdGate); contact-guard.ts refuses the same leads again at draft time. Research reads only the lead's own site (lib/outreach/research.ts researchUrl refuses social/platform hosts; lib/collect/canonical.ts siteScope bounds host and path; redirects off the scope are refused before the request), auto-approves a fact only when its excerpt is on the page and states the claim's numbers, weekdays and negation exactly (research-extract.ts autoApproves), retires a fact whose excerpt left its page (status stale, revived when it returns, a person's approval kept via reviewed_by), and fills an email only when empty, MX-checked, and either on the lead's own domain or a free-mail address the business declared (mailto or its schema.org Organization email). Raw keys never reach a normal table (connectors/secret/route.ts:7-10), and credentials_ref is never caller-supplied: it is always connectorSecretRef(id), and readers derive the vault name from the row id. A customer never drafts in the agency (organization_id IS NULL) mailbox; agency AI keys may serve a customer, billed through outreach.draft credits. Reply sync (lib/outreach/gmail-sync.ts, migration 0153): an email is marked sent only from its own Gmail message (co_mark_sent; one Gmail message maps to one co_messages row and one row has one sent event, unique indexes), so a sent first email never marks its unsent follow-up; a mail is stored only when it matches a lead by sender address, X-Failed-Recipients or a thread one of our mailboxes drafted in, claimed once by its Message-ID (co_replies.dedupe_key); every side effect of a reply (lead status, consent, follow-ups skipped and next date cleared, suppression for unsubscribe / reject / bounce, events, timeline) and processed_at commit together (co_apply_reply); a fifth failure marks it unprocessed, still stops follow-ups and pushes; the history cursor moves only after every page was read and no row is pending. Drafts need the outreach.draft grant, billed to the lead's organization, and the sampled fact check the outreach.qa grant, the same way (messages/route.ts billedTo).
declarations.dependencies: supabase (co_* tables and the vault of migration 0049), the customer's Google OAuth client (GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID / _SECRET, connectors/gmail/authorize/route.ts:28-29), AI provider keys per organization or agency from the vault, not env (messages/route.ts AI_PROVIDERS ladder), the entitlement gate. Code import inside the same app: actorFor from lib/social/authz (lib/outreach/billing.ts billedTo); the collect engine for lead research (lib/outreach/research.ts -> lib/collect/run.ts runLeadResearch, lib/collect/sinks/outreach-research.ts) and for lead discovery (lib/outreach/discover.ts -> lib/collect createProviderCall, Serper /places on the agency's SERPER_API_KEY under the outreach.discover grant), declared as products.ts dependsOn collect. No Trigger task; two host schedules (outreach_sender_health, daily 00:30 UTC; outreach_gmail_sync, every 10 minutes, reads each connected Gmail with gmail.readonly through google-oauth.ts gmailGet and classifies replies under the outreach.classify grant, billed to the lead's organization). Inventory: ADR 017 section 5 row outreach.
declarations.failure_isolation_boundary: A vault error on one provider moves on to the next provider (messages/route.ts, the vaultError branch); provider failure or no key or an unparseable reply after one repair turn falls back to a manual_prompt row, blocked until a person pastes the email back, with the error kept in ai_model (messages/route.ts POST). lib/outreach/db.ts helpers fail soft (db.ts:10). A Gmail draft whose status update fails returns a warning, not an error, so a retry does not create a duplicate draft (gmail-draft/route.ts, after createGmailDraft).
declarations.data_lifecycle: Hard delete only, through the DELETE handlers of connectors, inbox, leads, messages, service-profiles and suppression (app/api/outreach/*/route.ts); co_messages cascade with their lead, co_sending_events keep their row with lead and message set null (0048:138, :260-261); deleting an organization cascades every table (0048 foreign keys). No soft delete, no retention job.
declarations.observability_contract: Each draft keeps prompt_snapshot, evidence_snapshot, ai_model and gate_snapshot (gate version, findings, required parts, claim check, auto) (messages/route.ts POST); co_sending_events records draft_created with the Gmail draft id (gmail-draft/route.ts co_sending_events insert). There is no logAiCall, Sentry or console logging in lib/outreach or app/api/outreach (grep: none); errors surface only in HTTP responses.
declarations.migration_rollback_contract: 0048 has lobster-factory/packages/db/scripts/0048_co_outreach_core_down.sql, which drops all twelve tables in reverse foreign-key order and destroys all outreach data (header :1-5); it is run by hand. 0152 has migrations/0152_sender_pool.down.sql (same copy in scripts/), refused while a message is sending; claims and pool settings are lost.
declarations.replacement_strategy: Each AI provider is its own client file called with (grant, key, prompt) (ai-claude.ts, ai-openai.ts, ai-gemini.ts); Gmail is isolated in google-oauth.ts. The provider order claude -> openai -> gemini -> gemini_agency -> manual is fixed in messages/route.ts AI_PROVIDERS, so swapping a provider means editing that route.
